difficulty_reason: The authors identify the relational epsilon-distance with a fixed point of the lifted LP transition functional by constructing and extending maximal epsilon-bisimulations, comparing relation images with strict metric neighborhoods, and introducing a larger gamma to handle open-ball boundaries before taking infima. The full quantifier/inf-sup argument and prefixpoint-to-bisimulation/bound construction remain. This non-routine relation-to-metric coalgebraic characterization supports H2 as one fixed-point result; monotonicity/functor/unit lemmas are support or adjacent context, not separate counts.

Retain actual Lemma10 and current prefixpoint proof; no new-core import from excluded Section4 coupling equivalences.
